user.title: Device Inventory
user.description: Adds classified device tables (Shelly, ESPHome, ZigBee, ...) with photos, notes and print support. Nothing to configure.

init.title: AI for manuals
init.description: Optional. Choose the AI task entity of an AI provider set up in Home Assistant (for example Google Generative AI, OpenAI or Anthropic). Device Inventory then asks it for the manuals of your devices. Only the manufacturer and the model are sent; every address is checked before it is saved. Leave empty to turn it off.

data.ai_copy_local: Copy found PDFs to Home Assistant

data_description.ai_copy_local: Store the PDF manuals the AI found on your Home Assistant (config/device_inventory/manuals), so they work without internet.
